title: Ensure 'Access this computer from the network' is set to 'Administrators, Authenticated Users, ENTERPRISE DOMAIN CONTROLLERS' (DC only)
objective: Remediate CIS checkpoint 2.2.2: Ensure 'Access this computer from the network' is set to 'Administrators, Authenticated Users, ENTERPRISE DOMAIN CONTROLLERS' (DC only)

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

fields.name: raw_command_output
fields.description: Raw command output from the verification command

steps.name: Set 'Access this computer from the network' to 'Administrators, Authenticated Users, ENTERPRISE DOMAIN CONTROLLERS'.
steps.function: 1. Set 'Access this computer from the network' to 'Administrators, Authenticated Users, ENTERPRISE DOMAIN CONTROLLERS'. Recommended module: ansible.windows.win_user_right with action: set and the appropriate users list (empty list [] for No One, or named accounts). Do NOT use secedit — it does not manage User Rights Assignment.

steps.name: Verify 'Access this computer from the network' is correctly set.
steps.function: 2. Verify 'Access this computer from the network' is correctly set to 'Administrators, Authenticated Users, ENTERPRISE DOMAIN CONTROLLERS'. Use read-only PowerShell to query the value; changed_when: false.

steps.name: Store final remediation result and raw command output
steps.function: 3. Store the final remediation result in a variable named 'cis_result' using set_fact. Set cis_result to the overall remediation status (PASS/FAIL/SKIP/ERROR) derived from the last requirement's status variable. Also store the raw output from step-02 in 'raw_command_output'.

steps.name: Generate remediation report
steps.function:
4. Create a task named 'Generate remediation report' using debug msg with EXACTLY this format:
REMEDIATION REPORT — CIS 2.2.2
Reference: CIS Benchmark checkpoint 2.2.2
Then for each requirement: REQUIREMENT NN - {{ req_NN }}:
  With fields: Task, Command, Exit code, Data, Status (PASS/FAIL/SKIP/ERROR), Details.
End with OVERALL REMEDIATION: section containing Result: {{{ cis_result }}}

steps.name: Emit compliance result
steps.function: Output the overall compliance status and raw command output to the caller.

steps.function: Reached via rescue block on any unexpected task failure.

compliance_constraints: Use failed_when: false on all remediation tasks (except set_fact, debug) so all steps complete and report status

If the remediation targets a specific software/service (e.g., GDM, GNOME, sshd, httpd), FIRST check if it is installed. If NOT installed, SKIP all remediation steps. Do NOT install prerequisite packages.
reference_procedure:
To establish the recommended configuration via GP, configure the following UI path to
Administrators, Authenticated Users, ENTERPRISE DOMAIN CONTROLLERS:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local
Policies\User Rights Assignment\Access this computer from the network
